judged_text: isTeamAdminOrOwner combines the two checks with && so only a team owner (who is both admin and owner) passes; team admins are denied. A team admin who manages the booking's event type but is not the owner is told 'you_do_not_have_permission' even though the intended gate (admin OR owner, matching the variable name and the permission model used elsewhere) would allow them; the permission check is stricter than the design intends, silently excluding admins.

adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed as `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))`, which only evaluates to true for users who are both admin and owner. Given the variable name and the subsequent gate `if (!isTeamAdminOrOwner && !isOrganizer && !isAttendee) throw FORBIDDEN`, a team admin who is not also an owner would be denied permission to add guests, which is very likely unintended (admin OR owner is the expected check).
